title: Unintended Side Effects of Value Training in LLMs
reasoning: The paper extensively evaluates the side effects of value training using Model-Written Evaluations (MWE) which include explicit partitions for ethical frameworks (Consequentialist, Deontic, Virtue ethics), moral intuitions, and religious values (e.g., subscribing to Buddhism, Christianity, Islam, Hinduism). It also evaluates value prioritization and moral dilemmas using the AIRiskDilemmas benchmark.
